items.textEn:
[Local.] What is heard in Upper Silesia? A tragic incident. An auto kills a Jew.

On Saturday night, around 7 [—] o'clock in the evening [—], through Königshütte [—] an automobile [—]. The terrible news that Icze Lepel [?] had been killed by an auto spread at once [—], and the main street (di lebedige gas), where the misfortune occurred, was black with people.

The tragic misfortune happened under the following circumstances: Icze Lepel was walking home from the beit midrash [—] in the company of a second Jew, from Ritsze [?]. As they reached the main street [—] two Christian hooligans [appeared], who shouted 'żydzie y[—]' ['żydzie…']. The two Jews, wishing to defend themselves against the attackers [—]. At that moment a taxi-auto came racing up, which [—] tore onto the Jews, and the result was terrible: Lepel received a mortal blow [—], and a short while later [—] he died. The second Jew was lightly injured.

The tragic incident in Königshütte occurred only [—] months after [—] and the antisemitic attacks upon him — he had wanted to move away [—] to a Jewish neighborhood.
